items.criterion: A finished lesson is reported once and every award is recomputed from the stored attempts.
items.judgment: Report one finished session twice and read the stored points, the streak and the attempt rows after each report.

items.criterion: Two reports of one session arriving together produce exactly one accepted result.
items.judgment: Send two reconcile calls for one session at the same moment and count the stored attempt rows.

items.criterion: A streak freeze is consumed at most once for one account on one local date.
items.judgment: Read the stored freeze dates for every account and confirm no date appears twice.

items.criterion: The heart count is computed on read with the partial refill interval carried forward.
items.judgment: Read the heart count twice with no spend between and confirm the stored refill mark is unchanged.

items.criterion: A cross-account read of progress, hearts, streak or attempts is denied with the protected rows unchanged.
items.judgment: Call each protected read as a second account and compare the stored rows before and after.

items.criterion: A lesson session is assembled with exactly twelve exercises and the list is fixed for its lifetime.
items.judgment: Start a lesson, count the assembled exercises, then re-read the session and compare the list.

items.criterion: A standings tie is broken by the earlier last earning time.
items.judgment: Read the seeded cohort and confirm the tied pair sits at positions seven and eight with the earlier earner above.

items.criterion: A timezone change never shortens the current streak.
items.judgment: Read the streak, change the timezone, and read the streak again.

items.criterion: A near miss that is itself a taught answer is marked incorrect rather than accepted on distance.
items.judgment: Answer one exercise with another taught answer of the same length and read the graded state.

items.criterion: No write reduces a recorded crown count or relocks an unlocked unit.
items.judgment: Read the path, repeat an enrolment, and compare every crown count and lock state.

items.criterion: An unknown address answers with a not-found response carrying the product's own page.
items.judgment: Request an address that exists nowhere and read the status code together with the document title.

items.criterion: Every internal link on every public route resolves.
items.judgment: Collect every internal link from every public route and request each one.

items.criterion: A restricted account is offered practice or waiting and nothing to buy.
items.judgment: Read the heart-exhaustion routes for the restricted seeded account and scan every page it can reach.

items.criterion: Seeding the app a second time duplicates no account, no subject and no exercise.
items.judgment: Count the seeded accounts, subjects, units and exercises after the app has started.

items.criterion: A trace rebuilds in full from the stored attempt log.
items.judgment: Complete a session and confirm every concept the session exercised owns a stored trace.

items.criterion: Body text against its background meets the accessibility contrast bar.
items.judgment: Read the computed colours of the body text and its ground, then compute the ratio.

items.criterion: Nothing overflows sideways at the narrowest declared viewport.
items.judgment: Load each public route at the narrow viewport and compare the scroll width with the client width.
